# Implementation Skill

## Must Follow
- Prompt: `.github/prompts/implementation.prompt.md`
- Shared instructions: `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- Coding standards: `.github/instructions/coding-standards.instructions.md`
- Documentation: `.github/instructions/documentation.instructions.md`

## Tasks
1. Follow the approved implementation plan.
2. Implement using HTML, CSS and Vanilla JavaScript.
3. Implement only approved Jira acceptance criteria.
4. Use LocalStorage for persistence.
5. Test implemented functionality.
6. Create or update `docs/implementation-report.md`.
7. Update `docs/agent-reports/implementation-agent-report.md`.

## Rules
- Always update both documents.
- Never claim unimplemented features or unperformed tests.
- Do not expand project scope.
- Do not start coding without approval.
- Complete only after both documents are updated.
